Paint-a-Palooza is a community art festival designed to bring together students, families, and community members in support of our philanthropy, The Periwinkle Foundation. The event will feature a raffle, face painting, vinyl painting, community murals, food trucks, various vendors, live music, various sports activities, carnival games, and, our brand new activity, a 5k Color Run.

Join us to support our philanthropy, The Periwinkle Foundation! They support and hold Camp Periwinkle, a program that provides year-round camps, arts and survivor programs, and emotional support for children and families affected by childhood cancer and other life-threatening illnesses. Through these experiences, Camp Periwinkle creates opportunities for campers to build confidence, form lifelong friendships, and enjoy the simple pleasures of being a kid.
